stops.note: the root word from which the Zulu royal clan's founder took his name
his descendants and followers became known as amaZulu, 'the people of Zulu'
stops.meaning: personal name of the founder of the amaZulu clan

stops.note: from the ancestor Zulu kaMalandela, whose name means 'heaven'; Shaka built the Zulu kingdom in the 1810s
stops.meaning: the Zulu people or their language

current_meaning: the Zulu people or language of southern Africa; also used for the letter Z in the NATO phonetic alphabet and for Coordinated Universal Time
